# Dipak Vishwakarma

> Official profile, articles, and resources from Dipak Vishwakarma, high-ticket sales coach and founder of Authority Closers.

## Official pages

- [Home](https://dipakvishwakarma.com/): Profile and latest thinking.
- [About Dipak](https://dipakvishwakarma.com/about): Background, work, and public profile.
- [Articles](https://dipakvishwakarma.com/articles): Writing on buyer psychology, high-ticket sales, communication, and decision-making.
- [Videos](https://dipakvishwakarma.com/videos): Public video library.
- [Resources](https://dipakvishwakarma.com/resources): Sales resources and frameworks.
- [Contact](https://dipakvishwakarma.com/contact): Contact options and professional enquiries.

## About

Dipak Vishwakarma is a high-ticket sales coach and the founder of Authority Closers. His published work covers buyer psychology, consultative selling, objection handling, and confident decisions.
